page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Opening paragraph in roman type, then Arabic liturgical verse lines (right to left) alternating with Latin italic and roman text. No marginal notes, no running head, no catchword or signature. Page number 601 printed at the top right.

main_text.p: Primo autem loco accedant Melchitæ, quos hic Græcos appellat Hottingerus, & pro se primo loco laudat. Isti itaque in Troparijs ad Deiparam Mariam per circulum totius anni inter cetera hoc recitant ad vesperas Dominicæ in primo tono: [illegible, ~3 letters]

[illegible, ~3 letters] Mirabilissimum mirabilium obstupefacientium conspicit creatura, & lætatur ideo, atque exultat concipiente te sine semine, o gratia plena, quæ peperisti partum tuum ineffabilem, in quem Archangeli respicere non possunt, deprecare illum pro animabus nostris. Item ad Vesperas feriæ 2. in primo tono: [illegible, ~3 letters]

p.i: [illegible, ~3 letters] Concepisti absque combustione ab igne Divinitatis, & peperisti sine semine Do-

page.notes: The Arabic verse lines are not legible at this scan resolution, so they are marked illegible rather than guessed. The Latin is transcribed with u/v and i/j normalised and long s written as plain s. The printed "Vefperas" and "Concepifti"/"peperifti" were read as Vesperas, Concepisti, peperisti. "Diuinitatis" was read as Divinitatis. The final "mi-" is the start of the next line, set in italic as printed.
